name: Mini Sprinkler Sanyantr
benefit:
1. General farmers: Up to 70% of the grant
1. Small and marginal farmers, including small marginal/SC/ST/women farmers: Up to 75% of the grant
_eligibility_text:
1. The agricultural land should be owned by the applicant.
1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Rajasthan.
1. Farmers should have at least 0.2 hectares of irrigated cultivable land.
